assign.outcome:
**A Doc nested inside another Doc now renders its own top tabs as a left vertical rail, automatically** — no second title band, alternating E3/F2 stripes gone. `Doc.render()` calls a new `nested_in_doc()` (walks `.parent` for an ancestor `instanceof Doc`) and when true draws `"page doc-section"` + `this.tabs(...).ac("vertical")` with no `well()`, instead of `"page doc-page"` + `.block` + `well()`.

**Blast radius** — headless crawl of /framework/ + /notes/ (44 pages, selector `.doc-page .tab-panel .doc-page`) found exactly 12 real hits, matching static analysis one-for-one: [ux/Auth](/framework/ux/Auth/), [Wizard](/framework/ux/Wizard/), [Tree](/framework/ux/Tree/), [Course](/framework/ux/Course/), [Filter](/framework/ux/Filter/), [Menu](/framework/ux/Menu/), [Pagination](/framework/ux/Pagination/), [Tags](/framework/ux/Tags/), [core/new/0](/framework/core/new/0/), [core/new/1](/framework/core/new/1/), [core/new/starter](/framework/core/new/starter/), [DesignTool/taste](/framework/ext/DesignTool/taste/). All 12 fixed, none looked worse. /notes/ has no Doc pages at all.

**Verified** — pixel-sampled ux/Tree before/after: before alternates E3,E3,F2,F2,E3,E3,F2,F2…; after is E3,E3,F2,F2,F2,F2 then straight into content, no repeat. [ext/Doc/](/framework/ext/Doc/) (plain, non-nested) and [ext/Panel/Workspace/](/framework/ext/Panel/Workspace/) (already hand-fixed with the identical shape) are byte-identical sha256 before/after — zero regression. Console-clean at 1600 on all 6 spot-checked pages.

**Left alone** — `ext/Panel/Workspace/page.js`'s manual `render()` override (the prior art this fix generalizes) is now redundant but outside this task's file fence (`ext/Doc/**` only); a future cleanup could delete it.
